title: Initial run of the emitted iteration body
statement: Let $E$ and $G$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $e_e,e_x$ be states of $E$, and let $g_e,g_x$ be states of $G$. If $E$ has at least one work tape, then the emitted iteration body, started on any Boolean input $x$ in its initial configuration, reaches the anchor state after $3|x|+4$ steps with $x$ on its first work tape and all remaining work tapes empty. It does not enter the anchor state at any earlier time, including time zero.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ has at least one work tape
